name: Storybook
title: storybook.app
shortDescription: Storybook is a web-based editor designed for writers and storytellers to craft and share enchanting tales. It provides tools for writing, exporting, and sharing stories, making it ideal for authors, educators, and content creators. An example use case could be a teacher creating interactive stories for classroom activities.
